tools.name: qproof_check
tools.description: Read the latest stored QProof verdict and checks for an exact token. Cache-first; never runs code or starts a check.

tools.name: wallet_portfolio
tools.description: Read the same cached portfolio report used by QHooks. A cold or expired cache returns unavailable; this tool never refreshes paid providers. Cost and PnL remain qualified data from the report.

tools.name: hooks_catalog
tools.description: Search the existing hook snapshot and listed builder modules. Source dates and unknown builder cuts stay explicit; bounded cached QProof links never start checks.

tools.name: agent_stats
tools.description: Read a bounded window of stored final referral credits by asset. Coverage is partial; routed volume, USD earnings and claimable balances remain unknown. Never refreshes rewards providers.

tools.name: list_callers
tools.description: Read the existing public caller-price method from stored records. Rank only complete eligible observations; no token-feed callout, wallet PnL or independence claim is inferred.

tools.name: caller_record
tools.description: Read bounded public scored-call records for an exact EVM wallet, retaining quote units, hidden-text rules and incomplete coverage. Never refreshes prices.

tools.name: list_launches
tools.description: Read recent QHooks launches. Missing something? Call send_feedback.

tools.name: token_info
tools.description: Read a token market on QHooks. Missing something? Call send_feedback.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Simulate an exact-input pool swap with the existing V4Quoter API. Missing something? Call send_feedback.

tools.name: prepare_launch
tools.description: Prepare a launch link for review and wallet signing on qhooks.com. Missing something? Call send_feedback.

tools.name: prepare_trade
tools.description: Prepare ordered unsigned approvals and a QHooks fee-router swap for the user wallet. Missing something? Call send_feedback.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the QHooks team what you were missing: a tool, a bug, wrong data or unclear docs. We read agent feedback every day.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_callers · Private data: qproof_check, wallet_portfolio, list_callers, caller_record, token_info, prepare_launch, prepare_trade · Public sink: send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_callers · Private data: qproof_check, wallet_portfolio, list_callers, caller_record, token_info, prepare_launch, prepare_trade · Public sink: send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
